queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "docstream" WHERE lower(cast(message as varchar)) LIKE '%error%' OR lower(cast(level as varchar)) IN ('error','err','fatal')
SELECT service, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "docstream" GROUP BY service ORDER BY cnt DESC
